description: This file defines the interface for file system input/output functions in the Starboard platform, including file handle types, flags, error codes, and function prototypes for opening, closing, reading, writing, truncating, and deleting files.

methods.name: SbFileOpen
methods.description: Opens a file at the specified path with given flags, creating it if necessary, and returns a handle.

methods.name: SbFileAtomicReplace
methods.description: Atomically replaces the contents of a file at the given path.

methods.name: SbFileSeek
methods.description: Changes the current read/write position within a file.

methods.name: SbFileRead
methods.description: Reads data from a file into a buffer.

methods.name: SbFileWrite
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer into a file.

methods.name: SbFileTruncate
methods.description: Truncates a file to a specified length.

methods.name: SbFileFlush
methods.description: Flushes the write buffer to the file.

methods.name: SbFileGetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about an open file.

methods.name: SbFileGetPathInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a file at a given path.

methods.name: SbFileDelete
methods.description: Deletes a file, symlink, or empty directory at a specified path.
